title: Functional but not a fan of the ringer
text: Functional but not a fan of the ringer. It is easy to set and I bought it knowing it does not have a snooze option but I find the ringing to be so jarring that I don’t like to use it. I also don’t love that it’s essentially a 12 hr clock, no am or pm so you can’t set an alarm for 7am at 6pm the night before. Not usually an issue as I usually set my alarm when I go to bed and it’s almost always less than 12 hours till I would get up. But a couple of times I wanted to set it earlier just I case I might forget later that night and couldn’t, which was frustrating. As far as I can tell the ring and volume can’t be adjusted.
